extracted.message_text: Congratulations! You have been selected for a Virtual Internship. Please deposit a refundable security fee of Rs. 1500 to UPI ID techcareers@okaxis within 24 hours to secure your seat.

signals.label: Artificial Urgency Deadline
signals.evidence: within 24 hours of receiving this letter

tool_results.detail: Domain registered 4 days ago. Not associated with Google LLC.
Individual VPA format used instead of registered corporate merchant.

explanation: This offer letter shows strong signs of an internship recruitment scam. Legitimate employers never require applicants to pay a 'refundable security fee' or deposit money via UPI to confirm an offer. Furthermore, the email sender domain is not affiliated with Google.
next_steps: Do NOT transfer any money or pay the requested Rs. 1500 via UPI.
Do not share your Aadhaar, bank details, or personal ID documents.
Verify genuine vacancies directly on the official careers page at careers.google.com.
Report this fraudulent incident to the National Cybercrime Portal at cybercrime.gov.in or dial 1930.

family_alert.title: ⚠️ Caution: Fake Internship / Job Deposit Alert
family_alert.body: If anyone sends you a job or internship offer asking for an upfront registration or equipment fee via UPI, DO NOT PAY. Genuine companies never charge candidates money to start work.
tips: Never pay money to get a job or internship.
Check the company email address carefully (@company.com).
Discuss with a family member before transferring funds.

limitations: This assessment is based exclusively on the provided text and imagery. Absence of detected red flags does not guarantee authenticity.
